statement: A standalone header-only helper adds a submission-ordered capture-local draw/mesh registry bounded to 65,536 entries each and 16 MiB escaped JSON with generic UTF-8 asset paths, separate bounded generated-geometry keys and explicit unsupported coverage. Registered registry regressions cover refusal, IDs, metadata, bounds and reset.
